title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic Speaking Test 2 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: How well do you know the capital city of your country?
Do you think cities are exciting places to live?
Why do some people dislike living in a city?
If you could visit any city in the world, where would you go?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a time when you read or heard something that you thought was not true.
cue_card_bullets: why you thought it was not true
and explain how you felt about reading/hearing this thing that you thought was not true

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Do you think children are more honest than adults?
Why do adults tell children it's important to be honest?
Do you think there are sometimes good reasons for adults not to tell children the truth?
Are there any claims in advertisements that are sometimes not true?
Why do people still buy things even when they know advertisements aren't completely accurate?
Do you think advertisements that are dishonest should be banned?
